title: POST /v1/config request
description: Which build is asking, and which config schema versions it can execute. The version list is not a minimum-version pin: a version floor can brick a fleet that cannot move, and an explicit 409 on an unsupported config_version refuses cleanly instead of applying a document partially. The server decodes this request tolerantly, so new fields ship client-first. A build that knows its source catalog reports it in catalog, so a control plane can serve and validate against what each install can execute.

agent_version.description: The shipper build's canonical version string. The same value travels in the X-Shipper-Version header on every request.

config_versions.description: Config schema versions this build can execute. The server answers 409 when the intersection with what it serves is empty.

catalog.description: The build's compiled source catalog: what this install can collect, and which served-document features it reads. Optional: a client that omits it is served as before. Root templates are reported as compiled ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, ~/.claude), never expanded, so the catalog says nothing about the machine, its user, or its files. Sent on every config fetch.

sources.description: Every source this build can collect. A served document may only adjust these; it cannot create one. Across a fleet these are the sources discovered so far, not every source there is.

rule_packs.description: The scrub rule packs this build has. A served scrub.rule_packs naming another is refused by this build.

features.description: Served-document features this build reads beyond the config_version it accepts, by name. None is defined yet; a later field can then be served only to builds that list it.

id.description: The identifier a served document names in sources[].id.

family.description: The agent family, for example claude-code.

family_name.description: The family's display name, for example Claude Code.

description.description: What the source collects, in the catalog's words.

artifact_class.description: trajectory or context, as the catalog classifies the source.

enabled.description: Whether this build collects the source when no layer says otherwise.

roots.description: The compiled root templates, unexpanded. Globs are relative to the root that resolves on a machine.

exclude.description: The compiled exclude globs. A served sources[].exclude replaces them.

enrichers.description: The registered enrichers a served document may turn off.
